biography: Stephen Nuttall's journey into motorsport began not on a pristine track, but on the muddy fields of his family's farm in rural England. At the tender age of eight, he was already tearing around on a battered quad bike, honing his reflexes and developing an innate understanding of vehicle dynamics. He transitioned from farm machinery to karting, quickly demonstrating a raw, untamed talent that caught the eye of a local racing school. His breakthrough came in the Caterham Supersport championship where his aggressive overtaking maneuvers and relentless pursuit of the lead made him a formidable competitor. Despite facing setbacks, including a near career-ending crash in 2018, Nuttall has clawed his way back to the top, now considered to be in the prime of his career, consistently challenging for podium finishes and proving his mettle against seasoned veterans. He is known for his never-say-die attitude and willingness to push the limits, often at the expense of his equipment.
drivingStyle: Nuttall's driving style is characterized by its raw aggression and calculated risk-taking. He's known for late braking and daring overtakes, often threading the needle through seemingly impossible gaps. While some criticize him for being overly aggressive, his supporters argue that his relentless pressure forces his competitors into mistakes. He has a knack for extracting maximum performance from his car, even if it means pushing it to the absolute limit. Tire management isn't his strongest suit, often preferring a short burst of blistering speed over a sustained, consistent pace. Under pressure, Nuttall tends to double down on his aggressive approach, either securing a decisive victory or crashing out spectacularly.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision that cost Bellini the championship in 2020. The bad blood has only intensified since.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A clash of egos and driving styles. Dubois, known for her meticulous precision, publicly criticized Nuttall's 'reckless' approach, sparking a heated rivalry both on and off the track.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Tanaka and Nuttall are known to battle hard on track and sometimes make contact. They have immense respect for each other but neither gives an inch.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, regardless of the weather.
Listens to heavy metal music at ear-splitting volume immediately before every race.
Refuses to eat anything green on race days.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Caterham Supersport championship in 2017 after a season-long battle, securing the title with a daring last-lap overtake.
careerLowPoint: The horrific crash at Brands Hatch in 2018, which left him with a broken leg and forced him to spend months in recovery, questioning his future in racing.
